title: Informes con control de nota equivalente
requirement: POST /api/experiments optionally accepts noteSuccess. If present, require integer 0..sampleSize, recompute computedDifferenceVsNote=(dxpSuccess-noteSuccess)/sampleSize ignoring submitted derived value, preserve scientificallyVerified=false. Legacy two-arm reports without noteSuccess remain accepted and must omit computedDifferenceVsNote even if client spoofs it. Reject null, strings, negative, noninteger and out-of-range noteSuccess with 400 before storing.
